h2: Regular Pool Service Jimbaran – Scheduled Care for Your Villa
intro: If your villa sits between the salt air of Jimbaran Bay and the hard-water pipes running up Bukit Jimbaran, the pool takes a beating even when nobody's watching it. A Regular Pool Service Jimbaran schedule keeps chlorine balanced, equipment clean and scale from building up while you're away. After every visit you receive a WhatsApp report with photos, water readings and a note on what was done.

sections.h3: Salt Air, Hard Water and Hillside Pressure
sections.text: Villas in Goa Gong and along the Bukit edge deal with two problems at once: corrosive bay-side air eating through pump seals and fittings, plus mineral-heavy water that leaves white scale on heaters, mixers and filter housings. Up-hill properties also see pumps cycling constantly because tank pressure drops. Left unchecked, this combination clogs skimmer lines, kills circulation and turns clear water cloudy within weeks. Scheduled visits catch these shifts early, before a small seal becomes a full pump replacement.

sections.h3: What Happens on Every Scheduled Visit
sections.text: Each visit follows the same checklist so nothing slips through: vacuum the floor, brush walls, empty and rinse the skimmer basket, test pH and chlorine, top up chemicals if needed, then run the pump and filter cycle to confirm flow is steady. In larger family villas around Kedonganan with multiple bathrooms and bigger pools, we also check that backwash valves aren't leaking and that return jets are pushing evenly. You don't need to be present — just make sure the gate code works.

sections.h3: Getting a Quote – What to Send on WhatsApp
sections.text: To set up a schedule or request a one-off fix, message us on WhatsApp with a few clear photos of the pool area, the pump room and any visible scale or corrosion. Tell us roughly how often you'd like visits — weekly, fortnightly, monthly — and whether the villa is bay-side or up the hill. Pricing depends entirely on job size and condition, so we'll come back with a specific quote after seeing your photos. Everything stays in that one chat thread.

A few habits save money before scale and salt become expensive repairs. Wipe down pump seals and mixer cartridges every two weeks if you're staying locally; the bay humidity accelerates corrosion faster than inland areas. Flush the filter once a month even between scheduled visits, especially during dry season when dust settles on hillside properties. Keep chlorine above 1 ppm at all times — Jimbaran's warm water breeds algae quickly whenever levels dip overnight.

faq.q: How often do I need pool service in Jimbaran?
faq.a: Most bay-side and hillside villas here benefit from a visit every one to two weeks, but the right frequency depends on pool size, how many people use it and whether hard-water scale is already building up.

faq.q: What happens while I'm away from Bali?
faq.a: You simply stay reachable on WhatsApp. After each scheduled visit we send photos, water readings and a short note on what was done or flagged — no need to be on-site or arrange access separately.

faq.q: Do you also fix pump leaks and heater scale issues?
faq.a: Yes, pool equipment and villa plumbing fall under the same service. If a seal is corroding or scale is restricting flow during a routine check, we'll flag it in your report and quote the repair over WhatsApp.
